components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: Primary action trigger with Apple Blue background, spring scale, and luminous hover glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.4rem; border-radius: 980px; background: #0071e3; color: #ffffff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border: 1px solid transparent; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,113,227,0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0077ed; transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 8px 20px rgba(0,113,227,0.32); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); transition-duration: 80ms; }

components.name: Secondary Frosted Button
components.description: Subtle, translucent button using frosted glass blur and delicate border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 1.4rem; border-radius: 980px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); color: #1d1d1f; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

CONVENTION OVER CONFIGURATION

narrative.overview: TestFly merges the uncompromising aesthetic polish of Apple hardware product pages with the razor-sharp telemetry clarity of a next-generation engineering testing observatory. Every surface is built around pristine, high-contrast typography, frosted translucent materials (backdrop-filter: blur(20px)), and tactile, fluid micro-interactions powered by natural spring physics.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted Glass Luminosity: Real-time blurred navigation bars, floating status filters, and translucent pill controls.
Hardware-Grade Tactility: Pill buttons compress on click (0.97x) and lift smoothly on hover (1.02x with subtle luminescence).
Dual-Surface Consistency: Shared visual language between the developer documentation portal (docs-site) and the interactive test execution timeline (reporting).
Telemetry Precision: Clear, un-muddled status indicators (emerald pass, crimson fail, amber warning) using legible monospace code typography.

rules.name: The Glass Canvas Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds never compete with content; frosted white or OLED black acts as the quiet foundation, while vibrant Apple Blue is applied to ≤10% of any given viewport.

rules.name: The Semantic Status Rule
rules.body: Status colors belong strictly to test results, validation outcomes, and system alerts. They are never repurposed for generic decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Tightening Tracking Rule
rules.body: As font size increases, tracking tightens proportionally (from -0.01em on labels to -0.035em on display). Large titles feel sculpted, not loose.

rules.name: The Translucent Surface Rule
rules.body: Overlaid UI elements must utilize backdrop-filter: blur(20px) with a semi-transparent surface background and a 1px hairline border.

rules.name: The Pure Pill Action Rule
rules.body: Every standalone button and clickable filter tag must have a complete pill border-radius (980px). Boxy, sharp-cornered buttons are strictly prohibited.

dos: Do maintain the 44px minimum touch target height for all interactive buttons and navigation links.
Do use backdrop-filter: blur(...) combined with translucent surface backgrounds for sticky headers and elevated overlays.
Do preserve the spring timing cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) across hover transforms and micro-interactions.
Do test all color pairings against WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text).
Do respect the prefers-reduced-motion media query by falling back to instant transitions.
donts: Don't use generic saturated blues (like #0000ff); stick to the curated Apple Blue token (#0071e3).
Don't create sharp 90-degree rectangle buttons; always use the 980px pill radius for action triggers.
Don't apply heavy, muddy black drop shadows in light mode; use subtle ambient shadows.
Don't use status colors (emerald, crimson, amber) for decorative backgrounds or marketing slogans.
Don't nest interactive controls inside other interactive clickable surfaces.
